messages:
Nora: heads-up — brutal crosswinds on the Bay Bridge this morning, had to pull over and secure my bike. :bike: :wind_face:
Diego: same. 80% chance your umbrella becomes a kite.  
Priya: BART showing slowdowns near Embarcadero, delays ~10-20m per alerts. https://www.bart.gov/alerts
TransitBot: BART ALERT: service slower northbound due to signal checks at Embarcadero; expect 10-25 minute delays.
Sam: Caltrain local is packed, express got canceled so everyone crammed on the locals. recommend leaving 15m earlier if you can.
Nora: FYI 3rd St bus detour past Market due to a fallen branch, saw a tree crew on site.  
Priya: Facilities — is lobby coat rack still downstairs? worried about soggy backpacks.
Facilities: Coat racks on lobby level restocked with extra mats. Please avoid leaving umbrellas on the stair landings.
Diego: poll: WFH or brave the commute?
Nora: WFH today. bike + wind = no thanks.
Sam: coming in already, but might bail if BART worsens.
Priya: offering one spare seat from Embarcadero to SoMa at 9:20 if anyone needs it.
Diego: taking it if still free, thanks @Priya!
TransitBot: Ferry: on time but choppy. Muni: expect slower speeds on 22 and 47.
Nora: also saw a seagull snatch a snack at the waterfront, this city is wild.
Sam: anyone got umbrella recs that survive gusts? Ive lost three this month.
Priya: got a compact that lasted a year, DM me the link.
Diego: safe travels y'all. post pics of commute chaos and Ill compile into glorious heartbreak slideshow.
Nora: good luck out there, bring extra layers and maybe a helmet if biking. :helmet_with_white_cross:
